svg.title: Complete video production BPM workflow for all 114 CASOPS video agents
svg.desc: A top-to-bottom business process workflow covering intake, development and greenlight, pre-production, production, post-production, release review, distribution and archival, and post-release learning. All 114 video agents are shown once in their principal phase or in a cross-cutting orchestration, creative, research, optimization, and safety band. Parallel branches, quality gateways, human approval, targeted rework, correction loops, artifacts, and runtime status are identified.
svg.metadata: Synthesized from agents/video.*/SPEC.md and agent_spec.json, agents/video.orchestrator/sources/excerpts/agents.md, agents/video.worldbuilding/sources/excerpts/ai_agent_video_production_workflow.md, and agents/video.worldbuilding/sources/excerpts/ui_design.md. Principal placement is used for readability; many agents participate across phases. The multi-agent BPM is documented design intent. Current active agent runtimes are baseline-safe, local-deterministic, single-node DAGs with peer routing disabled.
svg.text: Video Production · Complete Agent BPM Workflow
All 114 CASOPS video agents · principal phase placement · governed artifact handoffs · targeted revision and learning loops

STATUS NOTE — This is the documented multi-agent production design. Active agent runtimes remain baseline-safe, single-node local_deterministic DAGs with routing, peer hops, tools, and production activation disabled.
Cross-cutting control, creative, research, optimization and safety services
Applied across every phase. These 28 agents shape, govern, measure, and remember work; craft and support agents own the phase deliverables.
USER + CONTROL PLANE · TEMPLATE A–J · SCALE S1–S7
A Viral · B UGC · C Explainer · D Personalized · E Short
F Training · G Music · H Avatar · I Documentary · J Feature
S1–S2 fast crew · S3–S4 premium · S5–S6 long-form · S7 feature
Gateway selects crew, rigor, render topology and delivery branches.
Estimate tasks, gates, cost, latency and risks
Initialize artifact manifest and project memory
Freeze brief scope and acceptance criteria
Open human approval and escalation slots
16 PRINCIPAL AGENTS · DIVERGE IN PARALLEL → GREENLIGHT
Scope, budget, audience value, brand constraints
Vision, treatment, series arc and campaign concept
Music, comedy, copy and age-appropriate narrative
Objectives, evidence, reporting and label direction
Treatment / objectives · KPI targets · budget envelope · rights-risk register · scale profile
Gate: Producer + Finance + Compliance + Planner + human when required
REVISE — budget, rights, feasibility or concept
12 PRINCIPAL AGENTS · PARALLEL PACKAGE BUILD → L1 SPEC + HUMAN APPROVAL
Lock performers, coverage and design references
Sets, wardrobe, hair, makeup and practical feasibility
Stage movement, hero assets and synthetic identity consent
Reusable systems, state and source package
Templates, immutable continuity baseline and archive rights
Script lock · boards / lookbook · asset IDs · bibles · consent · continuity baseline
REQUEST CHANGES — return only failed artifacts to owners
17 PRINCIPAL AGENTS · SCENES / SHOTS FAN OUT → PER-SHOT QC → L2 CRAFT GATE
Camera plans, framing, aerial and location-specific work
On-camera, creator-style and long-form narrated performance
Generate shots, diagrams and personalized render variants
Consent-aware voice, frame integrity and phoneme alignment
Blocker halts; major routes to the owning craft node.
Shot prompts · camera plans · performances · plates / takes · render telemetry
TARGETED RERENDER / RE-RECORD — preserve unaffected dependencies
11 PRINCIPAL AGENTS · PICTURE / VISUAL / SOUND / ACCESSIBILITY LANES → REVIEWABLE MASTER
Assemble story, pace, coverage and trailer hooks
VFX integration, graphics, grade and look consistency
Design, cue, rights-aware music package and masters
Sign interpretation, translation and cultural fit
Timeline · graded master · stems · captions / subtitles · QC report · outlet variants
13 PRINCIPAL AGENTS · EVIDENCE + AUDIENCE + SAFETY + DOMAIN REVIEW → L3 / Q1–Q6 / HUMAN GATE
Claims, standards, clearance and final high-risk sign-off
Preference, usability, access acceptance and jury read
Misuse, impersonation, disclosure, fairness and social impact
Learning outcomes and feature classification package
Mandatory human escalation: consent, novel legal/medical/financial,
journalism, ratings, festivals, crisis response, cultural sensitivity.
RELEASE PACK · L3 PREFERENCE + SIX-PASS DELIVERY MESH
Q1 spec · Q2 visual · Q3 audio/sync · Q4 continuity · Q5 perceptual · Q6 outlet readiness
C2PA / provenance bundle · sign-off log · unresolved-risk list
BLOCK / TARGETED REVISION — route to development, production or post owner
14 PRINCIPAL AGENTS · CHANNELS FAN OUT IN PARALLEL · EACH BRANCH READY / PENDING / BLOCKED
Ready → publish · Pending → fix branch · Blocked → hold outlet
Post-release observation, correction and continuous learning
3 PRINCIPAL AGENTS + CROSS-CUTTING RETENTION / ROAS / EVALUATION / MEMORY SERVICES
Version notice, affected package and provenance update
Content fix → post · package fix → distribution
it does not silently rewrite release.
REGRESSION-TESTED LEARNING → future development defaults (never silent live mutation)

Coverage: cross-cutting 28 + development 16 + pre-production 12 + production 17 + post 11 + review 13 + distribution 14 + post-release 3 = 114. Principal placement avoids duplicate roster entries; roles may participate in multiple stages.
Sources: video agent SPECs / active agent_spec.json files; orchestrator roster; documented AI video workflow; project-stage UI design. Generated for repository workflow analysis.
